note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). The total and every value are hypothetical placeholders labelled as such. Only the supplied relationships are drawn; a plain relation has no arrowhead and a causal link appears only when supplied. No share rule, percentage, apportionment doctrine, fault, liability or outcome is stated; the two supplied allocations are drawn at equal weight.
